page.notes: The Greek words in the line "vado" are printed small and partly worn; the reading τῆς μεθοδίας τῆς ἐν[?]ῆς is a best guess for the last word. The printed text has a few typographical irregularities, which are left as printed (for example "sactris", "stabiliverit" with the first letter damaged). The scan is faded and blotched in places, but the body text is legible.
